classes.name: cash
classes.description: banknotes: one box per stack or fan of notes lying together; a separate single note gets its own box

classes.name: id_card
classes.description: identity card or ID document, only when the document itself is visible (not hidden in a closed hand)

classes.name: cash_bag
classes.description: cash-in-transit collection bag or sealed money bag

classes.name: safe_key
classes.description: key, especially a key inserted in the safe lock

classes.name: personal_item
classes.description: personal belongings at the cashier workplace: jacket, bag, cup or glass; not clothes worn by a person

classes.name: door
classes.description: door of the cash room, whole door whether open or closed

classes.name: safe
classes.description: safe, whole safe whether open or closed

classes.name: laptop
classes.description: laptop or computer, whether on or off

classes.name: currency_detector
classes.description: banknote authenticity / counterfeit detector device, separate from the counting machine

notes: Order defines YOLO class ids; never reorder after labeling starts, only append. Prompts and descriptions only draft labels for human correction. The detector finds door, safe and laptop in any camera angle; their open/closed and on/off states are judged separately on the detected crop.
